[[File:Fernando.png|thumb|250px|Fernando]] '''Fernando''' (Japanese: '''ミツジ''' ''Mitsuji'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP146|Tricks of the Trade]]''. He was a very capable {{p|Tauros}} {{pkmn|Trainer}}, and was first seen managing his fifth consecutive victory in the Tauros competition of the [[Pokémon Swap Meet]] in [[Palmpona]], an unprecedented feat. In his next appearance, he had won his tenth straight battle and looked set to retire undefeated before {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Tauros}} arrived and successfully took the title away from him. Some time after the battle, Fernando met up with Ash during the Swap Meet with some other Trainers, informing him that his Tauros was great. He even offered to [[trade]] his {{P|Nidoqueen}} for Ash's Tauros. Ash declined this offer, however, much to Fernando's disbelief. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} ===On hand=== This listing is of Fernando's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Fernando |pkmn=Tauros |type1=Normal |gender=male |img=Fernando Tauros.png |epnum=EP146 |epname=Tricks of the Trade |desc=Fernando's {{p|Tauros}} was used in the Tauros battling competition in the Pokémon Swap Meet. He managed to defeat ten other Tauros, and put up an excellent fight against Ash's. However, Ash's Tauros was much stronger and hurled Fernando's into the arena wall, eliminating him from the matches and breaking the winning streak. Tauros's known moves are {{m|Tackle}} and {{m|Take Down}}.}} ===Mentioned=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Fernando |pkmn=Nidoqueen |type1=Poison |type2=Ground |gender=female |img=031Nidoqueen.png |epnum=EP146 |epname=Tricks of the Trade |desc=After Fernando lost to Ash in the Tauros battling competition, he came up to Ash, offering his {{p|Nidoqueen}} to trade against {{AP|Tauros}}. Ash declined this offer, however.
